method: Wall-clock timings from isolated local processes. Percentiles use the nearest observed sample; Professor timings start after module import and use no warm-up; Locker timings use a warmed local HTTP process and 20 concurrent unique-key requests. Mocked workloads are not production performance claims.

measurements.inputs: deterministic injected preprocessor/planner/agent, embedding, Qdrant hit, lock, memory, and send functions
measurements.interpretation: Pure orchestration overhead under mocks; excludes OpenAI, Qdrant, locker HTTP, Redis memory, Telegram, serialization, and actual route overhead.

measurements.inputs: unique keys, ttl_ms=10000, local Redis and HTTP loopback
measurements.interpretation: Observed local HTTP+Redis acquisition latency, not a capacity or production SLO.
